beats.label: S1 · The affair and the choice
beats.text: College freshman Margo has an affair with her married professor Mark Gable and gets pregnant. She keeps the baby against her mother Shyanne's fears, and Mark ghosts her.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up the paternity, the class dynamic, and the mother-daughter tension that drive every later conflict.

beats.label: S1 · Bodhi arrives, money doesn't
beats.text: Margo gives birth to Bodhi and is immediately drowning — fired from her waitressing job, abandoned by roommates, and stuck with rent she can't cover.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the financial desperation that makes OnlyFans a real option, not a lark.

beats.label: S1 · Jinx on the doorstep
beats.text: Margo's estranged father Jinx, a former wrestler fresh out of rehab, turns up and moves in. Shyanne is livid, but Margo takes him at face value.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Jinx as a live wire — his history and Shyanne's grudge are the fault line under the whole show.

beats.label: S1 · HungryGhost is born
beats.text: After accepting Elizabeth Gable's trust-fund deal that bars her from Fullerton and demands an NDA, Margo starts an OnlyFans as HungryGhost, rating subscribers' anatomy as Pokémon.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The account is the engine of the series; naming and pricing it is the pivot into her new life.

beats.label: S1 · Vegas and the viral leap
beats.text: Margo tells Shyanne about OnlyFans at her Vegas wedding to Kenny, blowing up their bond. She then collaborates with KC and Rose, and HungryGhost goes viral.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Bridges the private secret into public exposure and pushes Shyanne into the outside role she plays going forward.

beats.label: S1 · Custody war ignites
beats.text: Mark, alerted by the viral fame, files for full custody of Bodhi. A CPS visit follows an anonymous tip, and Jinx's positive drug test forces him out of the apartment.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The custody fight is the season's spine and its stakes carry directly into whatever comes next.

beats.label: S1 · Margo wins, Kenny confesses
beats.text: The court grants Margo primary custody with Mark getting two weekends a month. Kenny admits he was the anonymous CPS caller, gutting Shyanne's new marriage.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resolves the immediate legal threat but plants a fresh wound at the centre of Shyanne's household.

cliffhanger.text: Margo holds Bodhi and a growing OnlyFans empire, but her family has been remade by the fight to keep him. Shyanne's marriage is fractured by Kenny's CPS call, Jinx is clean but exiled, and Mark now has a legal foothold in Bodhi's life every other weekend.
questions: Can Shyanne forgive Kenny for calling CPS on her family?
Will Jinx stay clean now that he is out of Margo's apartment and back on his own?
How will Mark actually use his court-ordered access to Bodhi?

characters.name: Margo Millet
characters.line: Twenty-year-old college dropout and single mother who has turned an OnlyFans account into a lifeline and just won primary custody of her son.
characters.note: The HungryGhost persona is now her career, not a stunt.

characters.name: Bodhi
characters.line: Margo's infant son, the child at the centre of the custody fight and the reason every adult around him keeps making harder choices.

characters.name: Shyanne
characters.line: Margo's mother, newly married to Kenny but reeling from his betrayal, and still furious that Jinx is anywhere near her daughter.

characters.name: Jinx
characters.line: Margo's father, an ex-wrestler and recovering addict who relapsed on heroin, is now on methadone, and is living apart from Margo in Shyanne's old apartment.

characters.name: Kenny
characters.line: Shyanne's new husband, an Episcopalian youth minister whose secret CPS call — made out of concern for Bodhi — has just detonated his marriage.

characters.name: Mark Gable
characters.line: Margo's married ex-professor and Bodhi's father, who lost his bid for full custody but now has legal visitation two weekends a month.

characters.name: Elizabeth Gable
characters.line: Mark's imperious mother, who tried to buy Margo's silence with a trust fund and had her jaw broken by Shyanne for her trouble.

characters.name: Lace
characters.line: An old wrestling friend of Jinx's turned lawyer who represented Margo in the custody fight and is circling Jinx romantically.

characters.name: Becca
characters.line: Margo's best friend from home, now estranged after judging Margo's OnlyFans career at a New Year's Eve blowup.

characters.name: Susie
characters.line: Margo's remaining roommate, in on the OnlyFans operation from the start and shooting her early photos.
